title: Initialize Your Character
narrative: The System demands your identity. Define yourself using Python variables to become real in this world.
instructions:
Create the following variables to initialize your character:
- `player_name` — a string with your character's name
- `hp` — an integer for your health points
- `strength` — an integer for your physical power
- `defense` — an integer for your damage resistance
- `dexterity` — an integer for your agility
- `mana` — an integer for your magical energy
- `stamina` — an integer for your endurance
- `class_name` — a string for your class (e.g. 'Warrior', 'Mage', 'Rogue')

Remember: strings need quotes, numbers do not!
starting_code:
# Initialize your character!
# Example: player_name = "Aston"

player_name = ""
hp = 
strength = 
defense = 
dexterity = 
mana = 
stamina = 
class_name = ""
hints: Strings must be wrapped in quotes: player_name = "Hero"
Numbers are written without quotes: hp = 100
Make sure you spell each variable name exactly as shown!
